lateNight.headline: Still up,
lateNight.subcopy: the night gets quieter when you say it out loud. no pressure to be okay yet.
lateNight.heroAlt: Watercolor of a lamp-lit window against a deep blue sky

morning.headline: Good morning,
morning.subcopy: let's start with one breath. the rest of the day can wait its turn.
morning.heroAlt: Watercolor of dawn light brushing the edge of a leafing tree

afternoon.headline: Soft afternoon,
afternoon.subcopy: what part of the day needs unpacking? pick a door, or just sit with me.
afternoon.heroAlt: Watercolor of a figure resting beneath a leafing tree

evening.headline: Good evening,
evening.subcopy: what's the through-line of today — even if it feels tangled right now?
evening.heroAlt: Watercolor of a quiet garden flushed with golden hour

night.headline: Soft night,
night.subcopy: leave the loud version of the day at the door. we don't have to fix anything.
night.heroAlt: Watercolor of a still pond under a soft night sky
